name: Shaoxing Morning 2021
information: Competitors are only allowed to compete in one of the two competitions, **[Shaoxing Morning 2021](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Shaoxing-Morning-2021)** and **[Shaoxing Afternoon 2021](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Shaoxing-Afternoon-2021)**, in two half-days respectively.
